hook: 字根 tract＝拉、扯、拖——主角是拔河狂人。
script: 拔河狂人最會 attract 觀眾目光；一有風吹草動就 distract 對手。合約他要 protract 拖長，說過的話又能 retract 拉回肚子。別人一成功他就 detract 貶低；溫馴的叫 tractable，死都不肯被拉的叫 intractable。

members.speakLineZh: 清楚的論旨能吸引細心的讀者。

members.speakLineEn: Irrelevant details distract from the main claim.
members.speakLineZh: 無關細節會把人從主論點拉開。

members.speakLineEn: They protracted negotiations to exhaust the other side.
members.speakLineZh: 他們拖延談判以消耗對方。

members.senseAnchor: formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure; pull away from a source of disgust or fear
members.speakLineEn: The journal asked the authors to retract the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 期刊要求作者撤回該論文。

members.speakLineEn: One weak paragraph should not detract from the whole argument.
members.speakLineZh: 一段弱段落不該減損整篇論證。

members.senseAnchor: 易駕馭的；溫順的；易處理的
members.zhGloss: 易駕馭的；溫順的；易處理的
members.speakLineEn: The problem looks more tractable after we define terms.
members.speakLineZh: 定義術語後，問題顯得更好處理。

members.speakLineEn: Poverty remains an intractable policy challenge.
members.speakLineZh: 貧困仍是棘手的政策挑戰。

reviewHooks: tract＝拉：吸引吸引過來、分心拉開、拖延拉長、撤回拉回、貶低往下拉
tractable 拉得動 ↔ intractable 拉不動
pitfalls: detract from = 減損……的價值；不要寫成『攻擊某人』的唯一義
retract（撤回說法／縮回）≠ retreat（撤退）
protract 偏『延長過程』，不是『保護 protect』
